items.title: Joe Bushkin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: The interviewer mentions Ross Tompkins in the context of Bill Berry missing a performance; the interviewee does not mention Ross Tompkins or indicate a personal connection.

ctx.x: And amongst the technical musicians, it’s a far cry from the jazz field you know. We just ran into Bill Berry down in the lobby of the hotel, I got such a kick out of seeing Bill. And he’s talking about Robert Blake being a jazz fan. I met him when I was in town, he said he’s sorry he missed coming in to hear Ross Tompkins, at a place called Chadney’s, or whatever. There are so few jazz saloons that make any sense these days, it’s a lost art in its own way.
Overseas you ran into a couple of fellows.
